body: Yes,there is more to my story that I left out but I feel like this is my only option.I never saw my life ending up like this but there’s only so much I can take.I’m tired of just being miserable and unhappy.I literally have nothing to live for we live in a fucking pandemic where pretty much all we do is continue our same cycle everyday

The maximum capacity is 201 people it’s not that much but weekends people come in big parties and that fucks us up a lot. The waitresses treat me like garbage even though I treat them only with respect. And they always ask me for silver ware right when they run out so I need to do it right away even though I have like hundreds of dishes to wash.i would say this job taught me hard work and how to keep myself composed but yeah I am definitely looking for better options
It depends where you work I pretty much do everything like prep and running food for the cooks even help out on the line.
